concept.title: Understanding Linux containers
concept.shortdesc: Linux containers provide a lightweight method for isolating applications and their dependencies from the host system.

section.title: What are containers?
section.p: Containers are isolated environments that share the host operating system kernel. Unlike virtual machines, containers do not require a separate operating system instance for each application.

ul.li: Consistent behavior from development to production
